verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a rule engine for business entities and a no-code rule editor, which is the closest evidence to configuring customer risk logic. It also mentions 'explainable scores', but only for sanctions match triage. Nothing shows a configurable customer risk-factor model or a view of why a customer's risk score changed over time. Missing for 10: explicit customer risk-factor/risk-rating configuration, score-change history or audit explanation for customer risk scores, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed

citations.quote: Rules can be created around business entities through the rule engine.
run them through our proprietary no-code rule editor to pick up anomalous behavior
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
